summary: Complete backend testing of rewritten Composite Products system using admin catalog (productId). All 25 tests passed (100%). The previous critical bug (DuplicateKeyError on sellerListings) has been fixed - composite products now correctly set productId = compositeProductId when creating the composite sellerListing.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/business-tools/composite-products correctly creates composite with productId (admin products)
GET /api/business-tools/composite-products returns items with productId, hasListing, currentStock (dynamic from seller's sellerListings)
availableStock = min(component_stock / component_qty) calculation verified working
Components without seller listing correctly show hasListing=false and currentStock=0
PUT /api/business-tools/composite-products/{id} correctly updates name, price, description, items
DELETE /api/business-tools/composite-products/{id} correctly deletes composite + associated sellerListing
POST /api/business-tools/composite-products/{id}/sell correctly deducts from seller's sellerListings (lookup by sellerId + productId)
Sell fails correctly when seller has no listing for a component (400 error)
Sell fails correctly when insufficient stock (400 error with clear message)
GET /api/categories/all returns admin categories for dropdown
GET /api/products/by-category/{id} returns admin products for cascading dropdown
Firebase Auth is MOCKED - dev-test-token provides seller admin access
seed_data_creation: Used existing admin products: 699be9023cbe1a8c31591668 (Motor, stock ~41), 69aaf1febc2259c4124a5db0 (Round Bar, stock ~24). Seller has sellerListings for these products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Composite products now use admin productId (not listingId). Stock is dynamically calculated from seller's sellerListings found by sellerId + productId. The previous MongoDB unique index bug is resolved - composite sellerListings now correctly set productId = compositeProductId.
